notes: Per-character voice identity. kokoro_voice is the Kokoro-82M voice (default backend when its package and models are cached); local_voice is the macOS `say` voice; espeak_voice is the eSpeak NG voice used on Linux when Kokoro is unavailable. pitch_scale and rate_scale shape each character on top of the per-beat delivery profiles; pitch_scale applies to say and eSpeak only, since Kokoro keeps its own pitch. spoken_name is what the TTS engine says for the character (captions keep the brand spelling). runway_voice is sent to Runway when NOVA_VOICE_BACKEND=runway; Brodie is the current testing voice, so replace it per character once final voices are chosen. Casting is provisional until the owner signs off.
